curriculum.subject: Mathematical Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: make patterns involving rectangles, triangles, circles, and ovals

mission.title: make patterns involving rectangles, triangles, circles, and ovals

interactions.prompt: Look: circle, triangle, circle. What shape comes next?
interactions.retryHint: Say the two shapes: circle, triangle. Start the pair again.

interactions.prompt: Help the lion make a pattern: rectangle, oval, rectangle, ___. Tap the next shape.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the shape that completes the pattern.
interactions.retryHint: Find the shape that came after the first rectangle.

interactions.prompt: Make the next two shapes: triangle, circle, oval, triangle, circle, __, __. Tap them in order.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap each next shape in order instead of dragging.
interactions.feedback: Well done! The pattern is triangle, circle, oval.
interactions.retryHint: Read the first three shapes, then start that group again.

interactions.prompt: Which strip is a repeating shape pattern?
interactions.feedback: Correct! Rectangle, circle repeats again and again.
interactions.retryHint: Look for the same small group repeating.

interactions.prompt: Finish the kitenge border: oval, oval, rectangle, oval, oval, ___. Tap the missing shape.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the missing shape in the kitenge border.
interactions.feedback: Nice work! Two ovals, then one rectangle repeats.
interactions.retryHint: Look at the first three shapes and copy that group.

interactions.prompt: Show what you know. Make this pattern continue: circle, rectangle, triangle, circle, rectangle, ___. Tap the next shape.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the next shape in the pattern.
interactions.retryHint: Say the first three shapes, then find the one that comes third.
